item.title: Anthropic/OpenAI may be spending more than $1000 for every $100 you pay them
item.description:
📝 The experiment is: “How good is Claude Code anyway. That experiment is still running and Claude Code has by now created around 40k lines of code and a working (though incomplete) application. the end of an S-curve); And… while simple conversations with either budget or frontier models have become indeed ‘too cheap to meter’, the serious uses (like coding, complex reasoning) that require the recursive/indirection/tool-using/’thinking’ (not) models have exploded so much in token use that these uses have become very expensive.
🔗 Read more: https://ea.rna.nl/2026/06/07/anthropic-openai-may-be-spending-more-than-1000-for-every-100-you-pay-them/
